blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte had no involvement in the procurement contracts between GenCorp Industries Inc. and the Davao City local government unit (LGU) , a defense witness claimed on Wednesday. On Day 42 of Duterte’s impeachment trial, GenCorp Corporate Counsel Suzette Balucanag-Punay told the Senate impeachment court that while Duterte had a “loose investment” in a Jollibee Times Square branch in Davao City, the government contracts between GenCorp and the LGU involved the Jollibee Bolton branch. These two are among the five Jollibee branches operated by GenCorp, a company Duterte declared in her statements of assets, liabilities, and […]...
